Package spnego reads a Kerberos ticket from the Authorization header, so that a client with a TGT authenticates without a password and without an intermediate identity provider.

The token is passed through as the client secret for the kerberos auth manager to validate; nothing is verified here. The frontend does not hold the service keytab — the auth provider does — which is also why the SPNEGO exchange is one-legged: there is no way to return a mutual-authentication response token from this side.
